It is an annalistic chronicle that serves as a continuation of Geoffrey of Monmouth’s "Historia Regum Britanniae".  "Brut y Tywysogion" has survived as several Welsh translations of an original Latin version, which has not itself survived.  The most important versions are the one in Robert Vaughan's MS. 20 and the slightly less complete one in the Red Book of Hergest.
